title: graphty documents version 2: shared definitions
description: Definitions the version 2 schemas share: the header, ids, element references, rule trees, style layers and join steps.

timestamp.description: A UTC instant as JavaScript's toISOString() writes it, ending Z.

sha256.description: sha256: followed by 64 lower-case hex digits.

extensions.description: Data for other software, keyed by reverse-domain name. graphty and graphty.* are reserved. Kept unread on re-save. Allowed on a section header and on the closed objects of data and recipe (closedSlots).

ignorable.description: The members of this closed object that a reader that does not know them may ignore: it reports each W_UNKNOWN_MEMBER and keeps it. An unknown member not listed is must-understand.

closedSlots.description: The two optional slots of a closed data or recipe object: extensions, and ignorable. An object that carries ignorable validates with members besides its own, since this schema cannot tell an ignorable member from a must-understand one; one without it stays strictly closed (in draft 2020-12 the then branch marks every property evaluated).

header.description: The fields every section begins with (spec/README.md, 'The section header'). The top level of a section is open: unknown members are kept on re-save.

columnSchema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) fragment for one column, with graphty's keywords measurement (an open vocabulary: categorical, ordinal, quantitative, time) and unit.

columnDependency.description: A working column a reusable section needs, spelled as graphty-element's ColumnRef, and the schema the mapping step checks it against.

sources.description: The source role names the section names.

bindsToData.description: The data section id this section was written on.

typeName.description: A node or edge type name. It never contains a colon.

space.description: An opaque id space, compared exactly after NFC normalization, never parsed. A type name, shared:<name> and source:<source id> are only the names a writer proposes. Names beginning graph: are reserved and refused.

sourceId.description: src_ plus a ULID, minted by graphty-element and never reused; the reader source's id is always reader.

runName.description: A run's name within its recipe or namespace (the as of algo.run).

runId.description: Any string of these characters, in graphty-element's own minted form: <namespace>__<as> for a recipe-made run, the element's own id for a hand-started one.

setId.description: set_ plus a ULID; set_<namespace>.<ULID> once a recipe's set is applied under a namespace.

nodeRef.description: A node by record key. Closed: a reference with any other shape is kept and reported unbound.

edgeRef.description: An edge by record key: load names the source whose row made it, key its edge-id value, a reader-added edge's edge-id value or, with none, a minted ULID, or <copy id>#<row from 0> for a keyless row. Closed.

elementRef.description: A node or an edge, tagged.

position.description: A point in the scene frame (left-handed, y up, layout units). A 2D drawing writes z as 0.

number.description: A number, or one plain JSON cannot carry: Infinity, -Infinity or NaN, read as a number only where the declared type is number.

expression.description: A predicate in graphty-element's expression language (a JMESPath subset with no functions) over {data, results}.

path.description: data.<column>, results.<run>.<field>, a readable path (readablePath), or a value graphty-element provides under graphty. (a degree, a note value, a node value read at an edge's end). graphty.types, the saved graph's plural, is reserved and never a path.

edgeReading.description: Which edges come with a set's nodes: induced, listed, clipped, incident (an open vocabulary).

reusableRuleTree.description: A rule tree that names no element. all, any and not combine; every other kind is a leaf (an open vocabulary), passed to graphty-element's rule evaluator as written. No neighborhood seeds, listed nodes or item pinned to one run; source leaves name roles.

boundRuleTree.description: A rule tree in a dataset-bound section: element-naming leaves hold element references; source leaves name source ids.

channelName.description: A style channel (node.color) or a shader parameter address (node.shaders.<id>.<param>). An open vocabulary.

staticStyle.description: Channel values. Channel names are an open vocabulary; a reader fails an unknown channel alone. Values naming built-ins (node.shape, edge.style, arrowheads) are names from spec/builtins.md. A channel no layer sets is drawn with the renderer's own look, which is not part of the file's meaning (spec 4.2 rule 9).

binding.description: How a channel reads its value from the data. A channel no layer sets or binds is drawn with the renderer's own look, which is not part of the file's meaning (spec 4.2 rule 9).

unmapped.description: On a map: an element whose value the map does not hold is left as the layers beneath paint it. Absent, the value goes on through the scale.

binding.description: Closed: a member no binding has is reported and kept.

layerSource.description: The run, template or plugin that made the layer: a layer no run, template or plugin made writes no source, in style and view alike.

commonSelector.description: The selector kinds both style and view accept. Each known kind is closed; an unknown kind (an open vocabulary) fails its layer alone.

oneOf.description: member, rule and ids: the calling section's schema says which it accepts and how.
A selector kind a later release adds.

layerBase.description: A style layer. It has an id and no kind. Its top level is open; its selectors, bindings and carried palettes are closed.

asset.description: A model or image a section's layers draw (assets.md), carried in full in the section that needs it.

clashRule.description: What a cell an earlier source filled shows: keep the held value (the default), overwrite it, both (the held value, the incoming one as <column> (<source id>)), the min or max (numbers and dates), the mean (numbers), or the value most sources hold (vote; a tie keeps the held value).

clash.description: A step's clash rules: one rule for every column it writes, or rules keyed by working column name with "*" for the rest. Absent: keep.

joinStep.description: A join step: { op, source, ...choices }, naming sources by id in the join history and by role in a recipe. One source may be named by several steps. Closed. op is an open vocabulary: an unknown op holds the data section, or stops a recipe's replay. The members compare, membership and action are reserved and refused.

repeated.description: Rows of one key or one end pair: first or last (both on join.edges only). Absent: first on node steps; on join.edges, the graph's repeatedEdges decides.

mapping.description: The id-mapping table a step translates keys through. Its member many is reserved and refused.

unmatchedRows.description: On join.node-values (default leave-out) and join.edges (absent: the source's settings.unmatched).

part.description: A join.edges step's name among its source's steps: minted by graphty-element, never reused, never derived from a column name. Its edges are keyed under it.

columns.description: The working columns the step brings besides its role columns. Absent: every column (on join.add, every column no other step of the source moves onto nodes); []: none.

viaEnd.description: On join.edges: the end via or lookup translates.

duplicateIds.description: On join.add only: repeated keys; absent, the source's settings.duplicateIds decides.

ignoreCase.description: Match keys whatever their letter case. Every step but join.add.

ignoreSpaces.description: Match keys with every white space character removed. Every step but join.add.

off.description: Written only by graphty-element: the step is kept and listed but not built (a refresh left it without a column it reads).

copyId.description: A source's copy id: sha256: plus lower-case hex of the bytes (file, url and sample sources), or a ULID minted whenever the copy changes (network, derived and reader sources, and an embedded copy holding the reader's edits).

graphFilter.description: The shape of the recipe's graph.filter command without its op: which table a predicate keeps rows of, and the predicate.

joinRows.description: A step's rows or except: the rows whose cell in column is (rows) or is not (except) one of values, compared as exact strings after NFC, cells turned to text as keys are.

joinRead.description: A step's own roles, spelled as a mapping spells them: which table it reads, its key and end columns and their spaces, and on join.edges only its weight and time (null: none; absent: the source's role). A space is written exactly when its column is. Closed.

graphId.description: graph_ plus a ULID, minted by graphty-element and never reused; names one graph of a file holding several.

readablePath.description: A value graphty-element computes for every node or edge, read by its bare name: the element's one type, the first supplying source, every supplying source in step order, its record key's space and key, its resolved time, an edge's own weight, and its draft state while a draft is displayed.

draftState.description: The values graphty.draft reads while a draft is displayed. Never saved as data; a layer or filter may test them.
